commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Mateus Mane (Wolves) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Stefan Ortega.
90+1' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) pounces on a cross into the middle of the box, but plants his header well wide of the right post.
90+1' We will have 3 min. of added time.
86' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
81' High and wide! Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
79' Neco Williams (Nottingham) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
78' Substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) on for Angel Gomes.

77' Morato (Nottingham) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the right-hand post. However, he couldn't beat Jose Sa, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
76' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
75' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

74' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.
71' Lorenzo Lucca comes off the pitch to be replaced by Igor Jesus (Nottingham).
71' Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) beats several players before unleashing a long-range shot on goal that flies miles wide of the left post.
70' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

59' Mateus Mane (Wolves) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Stefan Ortega makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
57' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) will take a corner kick.
57' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

56' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) takes the corner.
55' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) will deliver the corner kick.

55' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
54' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
51' Nottingham have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
49' Wolves have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
48' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
47' Wolves are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
46' The whistle blows and Tim Robinson starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A loose ball is pounced on by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Jose Sa is alert and makes a comfortable save.
45' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but Jose Sa comes off his line to gather the ball.
44' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
43' The referee signals a free kick from long distance for Wolves.

39' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Jose Sa!
37' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) serves up a nice cross, but Jose Sa punches the ball away.
36' Neco Williams (Nottingham) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Jose Sa was alert and made a comfortable save.
33' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.

31' Ambitious effort from Lorenzo Lucca (Nottingham). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
28' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
27' A cross by Ola Aina (Nottingham) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
26' Angel Gomes (Wolves) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
25' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
23' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) attempts to chip the defensive wall, but they make the block.
20' Jose Sa makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) after a cross from the side.

14' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored!
13' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
10' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Jose Sa makes a comfortable save.
9' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
7' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the right post.
4' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jose Sa, who smothers the ball.
4' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
4' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham).
3' Neco Williams (Nottingham) tries his luck with a long-range shot from a rebound, but it isn't precise at all and the ball flies well wide of the right post towards the corner flag. Very poor shot.
3' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nottingham.
2' Ola Aina (Nottingham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
2' Nottingham hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
